about:
Solarise Solar operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, and has been installing residential solar systems since 2016. The company does not disclose its founders or ownership structure in the available materials.

The business focuses on residential solar panel installation, battery backup system integration, and free solar evaluations with energy analysis. Its installation team carries collective experience from over 13,000 solar projects, and every installation is backed by an industry-leading 30-year warranty. The company also offers leased solar energy system options for homeowners who prefer not to purchase equipment outright.

Solarise Solar serves homeowners across Colorado, including municipalities such as Highlands Ranch, and works with utility providers like Black Hills Energy on interconnection and incentive programs. Its customer base consists primarily of residential property owners seeking to reduce energy costs and achieve energy independence.

The company states it was built around a commitment to benefit the customer, the environment, and employee satisfaction. It emphasizes transparency, accountability, clear communication, adherence to industry best practices, and active listening as core differentiators, and maintains an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau.
